lineage.description: Point location data for energy infrastructure facilities (gas stations, power stations, substations, transformers) were collected and mapped by Uganda Bureau of Statistics during the National Census Mapping Programme (2009-2012). The dataset contains spatial coordinates and administrative location attributes for each facility.
